# gitea_milestone (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve details of a repository milestone in Gitea.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_milestone" "example" {
  user = "my-org"
  repo = "my-repo"
  id   = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Milestone ID
- `repo` (String) Repository name
- `user` (String) User or organization owner of the repository

### Read-Only

- `closed_issues` (Number) Number of closed issues in milestone
- `description` (String) Milestone description
- `due_on` (String) Due date/timestamp
- `open_issues` (Number) Number of open issues in milestone
- `state` (String) Milestone state (`open` or `closed`)
- `title` (String) Milestone title
